summary: No. On BTC, ETH and SOL, price did no better after it pulled back through the 0.705 or 0.618 level of an up-leg than after a random candle. The same holds for time spent in the discount half of the leg, on 1h, 4h and daily. The one result that holds up is on the short side: on 1h in downtrends, shorts after price retraced up through 0.705 of a down-leg did 0.24% worse than random.

verdicts.text: No better than random entries on 1h, 4h or daily. This holds at either level, with or without the 3%+ up-leg filter.
Entering on every candle in the lower half of a 3%+ up-leg landed inside the luck band on all three timeframes, in uptrends and downtrends.
Pooled, it landed inside the luck band on 1h, 4h and daily. The exception is 1h in downtrends, where shorts after the cross did 0.24% worse than random at 20 candles and also at 10.
Pooled, it showed nothing on any timeframe. It looked worse than random in one regime on 1h and one on 4h, and each result vanishes without a single stretch of signals.

notes: On 1h, price crossing down through 0.705 of an up-leg gave 2,568 entries in 1,526 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.07% behind random entries, inside the luck band. The 0.618 level fires about a fifth more often and lands in the same place. Requiring an up-leg of 3%+ barely changes the count.

On 4h the 0.705 cross was 0.2% ahead of random, also inside the band. In downtrends it reached 0.85% ahead, but the band there runs to 0.89%, so that is still chance. In uptrends it was 0.33% behind, also inside its band.

Holding a long while price sat in the discount half of a 3%+ up-leg enters on far more candles than the 0.705 cross on 1h: 27,645 entries in 1,960 separate moves. It was 0.04% behind random after 20 candles, inside the band. In uptrends it was 0.12% behind, just inside a band that starts at -0.13%.

On the short side, the 0.705 retrace of a down-leg on 1h showed nothing pooled or in uptrends. In downtrends, shorts after it did 0.24% worse than random downtrend shorts after 20 candles. That holds without its strongest stretch, signals on Jan 13, 2023, and at 10 candles, but not at 50 or 100. After the retrace, price moved against the short more than after a random candle.

Shorting while price sat in the premium half of a 3%+ down-leg looked worse than random in uptrends on 1h, but only because of signals between Mar 26, 2021 and Mar 28, 2021. Without them, it is chance. On 4h it was 0.47% behind in downtrends, but only because of 38 entries between Jan 2, 2023 and Jan 14, 2023. That 4h downtrend result does show at 50 and 100 candles.

Daily signals are rare. On daily the 0.705 cross of an up-leg gave 87 entries in 61 moves, and the 3%+ filter changes nothing, since both settings give the same 87 entries. In uptrends that long cross has too few moves to judge, and so does the short cross in downtrends.

For a long DCA bot, the 0.705 or 0.618 pullback gives no timing advantage over a random entry on 1h, 4h or daily, so the DCA orders and take profit do the work. For a short bot on 1h, the 0.705 retrace in a downtrend is a reason to leave the setting out, because price moved against shorts there more than at random. OTE levels mark where a pullback sits inside the leg, not whether the pullback ends there.
